rt:model.rt:sub: Sub Show_Data() If pv_1 != Nothing Then Dim RL As Double Dim RH As Double Dim CV As Double RL = pv_1.RangeLow RH = pv_1.RangeHigh CV = pv_1.Value If CV < RL Then CV = RL ElseIf CV > RH Then CV = RH End If txt_marks_V_min.text = RoundAscii(RL, pv_1.RoundDigits, True) txt_marks_V_max.text = RoundAscii(RH, pv_1.RoundDigits, True) Dim Fill_value As Float If fill_from_zero && (RL < 0) && (RH > 0) Then zero_line.visibility = "visible" Dim Z_pos As Float Z_pos = -280 * RL / (RH - RL) zero_line.x1 = Z_pos zero_line.x2 = Z_pos If CV >= 0 Then V_bar.x = Z_pos V_bar.width = (280 - Z_pos) Fill_value = CV / RH Else V_bar.x = 0 V_bar.width = Z_pos Fill_value = -CV / RL End If Else zero_line.visibility = "hidden" Fill_value = (CV - RL) / (RH - RL) End If If Fill_value > 1 Then Fill_value = 1 ElseIf Fill_value < -1 Then Fill_value = -1 End IF V_bar.rt_fillx = Fill_value V_bar.fill = Color_NB(pv_1) Else V_bar.fill = Color_ANA_ER_LINK End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If PvNR > 0 Then pv_1 = ANA(PvNR) End If
